hero.subtitle: myhouz gives your whole household one place to track what needs doing, what needs buying, and what needs fixing — so nothing gets lost and no one gets nagged.

problems.title: Sound familiar?
problems.subtitle: Every shared home deals with the same headaches. You do not have to.
problems.pain1Title: The grocery list only exists in one person's head
problems.pain1Body: And when that person is unavailable, everyone else either waits, guesses, or comes home with the wrong thing.
problems.pain2Title: The group chat is useless for anything important
problems.pain2Body: The fridge repair reminder got buried under 47 memes and a debate about dinner. Good luck finding it.
problems.pain3Title: No one can remember who agreed to fix the faucet
problems.pain3Body: It came up three weeks ago. Someone said they'd handle it. The faucet still drips. The conversation is gone.
problems.pain4Title: Something breaks and no one knows who to call
problems.pain4Body: The plumber's number is in someone's old texts. The building manager's name is a mystery. Time's ticking.

features.title: Everything your household needs.
features.subtitle: Built around how real households actually work — not how a productivity consultant thinks they should.
features.itemsDescription: Stop holding the shopping list in your head. Track everything the house needs — to buy, repair, or fix — assign it to someone, and mark it done when it's handled.
features.routinesDescription: The weekly clean, the plant watering, the trash day reminder. Set it once and everyone always knows what's done and what's still waiting.
features.remindersDescription: Renew the lease. Pay the bill. Replace the filter. Assign reminders to the right person and stop relying on memory.
features.urgentDescription: Something broke. Flag it as urgent and every household member knows instantly — no need to spam the chat or hope someone reads it.
features.membersDescription: Share a link. That is it. Your roommates, partner, or family are in your household in seconds — no account setup required on their end.
features.dashboardDescription: Open the app and see exactly where things stand — what is overdue, what is urgent, and what someone already took care of.

howItWorks.title: Up and running in 3 steps
howItWorks.subtitle: No setup guide. No onboarding call. Just your household, organized.
howItWorks.step1Description: Sign up and give your home a name. Thirty seconds. No credit card. You are in.
howItWorks.step2Description: Send a link. Roommates, partner, family — whoever lives with you joins instantly from their phone.
howItWorks.step3Description: Add what needs doing, assign it to the right person, and watch the house actually stay on top of things.

legal.p1Body: myhouz ("we", "our", "us") is committed to protecting your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and safeguard your information when you use our household management platform, including the website and mobile application (collectively, the "Service"). By using the Service, you agree to the collection and use of information in accordance with this policy.
legal.p2Intro: We collect information in the following categories:
legal.p2a1: Name, email address, and profile photo (when provided)
legal.p2a2: Authentication data managed through Supabase Auth
legal.p2b1: Items, routines, reminders, and urgent problems you create
legal.p2b2: Task completions, streaks, and activity history
legal.p2b4: Device information (browser type, operating system, screen size)
legal.p2c1: IP address and approximate location (country/region level only)
legal.p2c2: Authentication cookies and session tokens required for secure access
legal.p3a: Provide, operate, and maintain the Service
legal.p3b: Manage your account and household memberships
legal.p3c: Send essential service communications (password resets, invitations)
legal.p3d: Improve and optimize the platform based on usage patterns
legal.p3e: Prevent fraud, abuse, and ensure the security of the Service
legal.p4Intro: We do not sell your personal data. We share data only with the following third-party services, strictly for operational purposes:
legal.p4a: Supabase — database hosting, authentication, and Row Level Security enforcement
legal.p4b: Sentry — error monitoring and crash reporting (anonymized diagnostic data only)
legal.p4c: Legal authorities — only when required by law or to protect our legal rights
legal.p5Body: Your data is retained as long as your account is active. When you delete your account, all personal data is permanently removed within 30 days. Household data owned solely by a deleted account is also deleted. Anonymized, aggregated data may be retained for analytics purposes.
legal.p6Intro: You have the following rights regarding your personal data:
legal.p6a: Access — request a copy of the personal data we hold about you
legal.p6b: Correction — request that we correct inaccurate or incomplete data
legal.p6c: Deletion — request that we delete your personal data and account
legal.p6d: Export — request a machine-readable export of your data
legal.p6e: Withdraw consent — opt out of non-essential data processing at any time
legal.p7Body: We implement industry-standard security measures including encryption in transit (TLS), encryption at rest, and Row Level Security (RLS) policies at the database level to ensure that users can only access data within their own household. However, no method of electronic transmission or storage is 100% secure.
legal.p8Body: The Service is not directed to children under the age of 13. We do not knowingly collect personal data from children under 13. If you believe we have inadvertently collected such data, please contact us so we can promptly delete it.
legal.p9Body: If you are located in Brazil, you are entitled to the rights provided under the Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados (LGPD), including the right to access, correct, delete, and port your data. Our data processing is based on your consent and the legitimate interest of providing the Service. You may exercise your rights by contacting us at the email below.
legal.p10Body: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify you of any material changes by posting the new policy on this page and updating the effective date. Your continued use of the Service after any changes constitutes acceptance of the updated policy.
